items.title: Deterministic Simulation Testing
items.summary:
Distributed systems are hard to test because partial failures overlap
     with live traffic and the same fault can produce different execution traces
     on different runs. Unmesh Joshi describes how
     deterministic simulation testing addresses this by replacing real clocks,
     networks, and storage with simulated components driven by a single-threaded
     execution loop. This allows simulating both hard failures and routine

        A bug fix release for LLM, mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software.
Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1, which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code.
Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL:
select json_object('a', (select json_array(1)))

Returns this:
{"a":[1]}

But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this:
{"a":"[1]"}
